meta: Plan your child's birthday party with AI: three days left and nothing ready? AI helps you plan a small party in ten minutes.

muc.title: Last-minute planning
muc.text: Your child's birthday is in three days and nothing is ready. AI helps you plan a small party in ten minutes.

muc.title: Five things to tell it
muc.text: Give the number of guests, the kids' ages, the budget, the venue and a theme your child loves, like dinosaurs.

muc.title: A day-by-day task list
muc.text: Ask AI for a task list by day, plus a shopping list and a ninety-minute party schedule.

muc.title: Ask about allergies first
muc.text: Ask the guests' parents about food allergies first, then tell AI to avoid those foods. Check prices at the shop yourself.

muc.title: Three party games
muc.text: Ask a chatbot for three games for ten six-year-olds in a small living room.
